[Intro]
[C]
A

[Verse 1]
[C7]bad little kid moved
into my neighborhood
He
won't do nothing right just
sitting down and looks so good
He
[F7]don't want to go to school
and learn to read and write
Just
[C7]sits around the house and plays the
rock and roll music all night
Well, he
[G]put some tacks on teachers chair
[F]Puts chewing gum in little girl's hair
[C7]Hey, junior, be-
have yourself [G]

[Verse 2]
[C7]Buys every rock and roll
book on the magazine
stand
Every
dime that he get is
lost to the jukebox man
Well he
[F7]worries his teacher till at
night she's ready to poop
From
[C7]rocking and arolling
spinning in a hula
hoop
Well this
[G]rock and roll has got to stop
[F]Junior's head is hard as rock
[C7]Now, junior, be-
have yourself [G]

[Interlude]
[C7]
[F7]
[C7]
[G]
[F]
[C7]
[G]

[Verse 3]
[C7]Going tell your mama you
better do what she said
Get
to the barber shop and get that
hair cut off your head
[F7]Threw the canary and you
fed it to the neighbors cat
You
[C7]gave the cocker spaniel a
bath in mother's laundramat
Well,
[G]mama's head has got to stop
[F]Junior's head is hard as rock
[C7]Now, junior, be-
have yourself [C]
title: Bad Boy
tuning: E A D G B E
